observations.body: The Feast of Weeks is called the day of firstfruits and receives a holy convocation, rest from regular work, and specified offerings in addition to the continual offering.
observations.label: The day of firstfruits receives its offerings

payload.posture: Read Numbers 28:26–31 as one movement in Pentecost, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states the Feast of Weeks is called the day of firstfruits and receives a holy convocation, rest from regular work, and specified offerings in addition to the continual offering. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Pentecost.
